en.headline: Hong Kong rowers take two Asian Games silvers in an hour
en.dek: Winnie Hung Wing-yan finished second in the lightweight single sculls, then Cheung Yuen-shan and Leung Ying-on won the lightweight double sculls.
body: Hong Kong's rowing team collected two silver medals on Thursday morning at the Nagaragawa International Regatta Course, the squad's first medals of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games.

Winnie Hung Wing-yan, competing at her third Asian Games, led the women's lightweight single sculls through the first 1,000 metres of the 2,000-metre final. An Iranian rival overtook her around the 1,500-metre mark. Hung held second to the line in 7 minutes 28.54 seconds, nearly four seconds behind the winner. Thailand took bronze.

Cheung Yuen-shan and Leung Ying-on then won silver in the women's lightweight double sculls. Starting in lane four, they sat near the back of the five-boat field through the first kilometre, moved into third with 500 metres left and passed the Japanese crew in the closing strokes by 0.03 seconds. Hong Kong finished in 6 minutes 59.24 seconds, more than five seconds behind Iran, according to RTHK.
Chan Chi-fung placed fifth in the men's single sculls final. Siobhan Haughey later on Thursday races the women's 50 metres freestyle final after qualifying second in the morning heats.

zh.headline: 港隊賽艇一朝兩銀 洪詠甄與雙人艇組合齊上頒獎台
zh.dek: 洪詠甄女子輕量級單人雙樞艇先摘銀，張菌珊與梁穎桉隨後在雙人雙樞艇後上再添一銀。
body: 港隊周四早上在長良川國際賽艇場連奪兩面銀牌，為賽艇隊今屆愛知・名古屋亞運打開獎牌戶。
第三度出戰亞運的洪詠甄在女子輕量級單人雙樞艇決賽排第二線，首1000米一直領先，約1500米被伊朗選手趕過，其後守住第二位以7分28秒54衝線，較金牌得主慢近4秒。銅牌由泰國選手取得。
張菌珊與梁穎桉隨後在女子輕量級雙人雙樞艇決賽再添一銀。兩人排第四線起步，首1000米在五隊之中一度包尾，最後500米升上第三，終點前以0.03秒之微趕過日本組合，時間為6分59秒24，較奪金的伊朗組合慢超過5秒。
陳至鋒在男子單人雙樞決賽排第五。何詩蓓同日稍後出戰女子50米自由泳決賽，早段初賽已以總成績第二晉級。
